crossRefs.note: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy…
Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you…
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the…
For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
translations.bsb: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
translations.kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
translations.asv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.
